name: Khatal's Rejuvenation
description: Supports Skills that generate Remnants. Picking up Remnants from Supported Skills grants Khatal's Rejuvenation.
keywordDefinition: Khatal's Rejuvenation stacks up to 8 times and grants 5% increased Cooldown Recovery Rate per stack. Each stack of Khatal's Rejuvenation lasts for 10 seconds.
